source_file: Methods/NMFS-Method/4 CPaulsen archived files/Paulsen 2002-2008/Charlie 08-2012/data/2008 SAS data extract pgms.sas
source_program: adults V2.sas (program 2 of 4 in the file)
notes: Second program: derives river region from the tag_km river-kilometer code via substr(tag_km,1,3) (522 -> Snake, 539 -> Yakima, > 539 -> Upper Col), assigns Jack/Adult life_stage from age_at_return, then PROC SORT/CONTENTS/MEANS and a multi-way PROC FREQ with crosstabs (species*run, species*rear_type, life_stage*region). The program reads sasdata.upstream_at_BON_v1 (the output of program 1); autoexec.sas supplies a 12-row mock of v1 with the columns the V2 step consumes, with tag_km coded so the substr classification lands rows in Snake and Upper Col. The author's classification logic and PROCs are kept verbatim; one cosmetic 'options sysprintfont=' line was removed.
